synthetic_cli.note: Explicit synthetic HTTP fixture; not real-model quality evidence.

contracts.inline: search and expansion use the same read transaction; their two manifests commit together after it closes
contracts.standalone: inherits collection/space/source-key/MIME scope; compares ready generations, revision IDs, state versions and graph versions; changed snapshots fail STALE_SNAPSHOT
contracts.history: fetch expansion returns stored immutable evidence with historical=true, without traversing current data
contracts.graph: generation-owned structural edges, locators and original-source reference intent commit atomically with content/indices
contracts.references: CommonMark links via pinned Marko source spans; source-key directives; original conversation links/reply_to; retained native Docling hyperlinks. Targets resolve only inside the snapshot; no URL or file fetch.
contracts.similar: opt-in exact cosine top-N using stored vectors in the same space and snapshot, explicitly inferred
contracts.budgets: seeds included; canonical compact UTF-8 JSON of the complete evidence value is token/byte counted using the locally cached captured tokenizer, without special tokens or truncation

scope_and_limits: Standalone historical traversal is intentionally not provided. Changed state needs a new search; saved expansion replay remains available.

Old manifests without state snapshots remain readable but cannot be expanded. v4 graphs are backfilled without model calls; graph-limit failures preserve old search/original access and report GRAPH_UNAVAILABLE.
Structural group edges connect consecutive members, not every pair. Parent/child edges use representative chunks for observed section hierarchy, not a claim of text containment.

References are limited to supported original syntax and metadata retained by the adapters. Missing native hyperlink metadata, external unregistered targets and prose-implied references are not guessed.
Semantic graph edges use configured top-N and threshold; cosine is not a probability or proof of identical facts. Exact similarity is O(N) per expanded node.
max_edges counts processed candidates; at most one extra candidate is fetched to detect truncation. It is not a bound on internal SQL scan work.
Token/byte accounting covers evidence only, not the API wrapper, scope or usage metadata. A different downstream model can have different token counts.
No arbitrary summaries are created to fit budgets. Distinct chunks retain distinct provenance even when their text is equal.
Remote model weights remain operator/probe declarations as already tracked in P03-06; broad quality/scale evaluation remains P07.
preservation: No source database deletion, worker-seat cleanup, cloud-resource mutation, branch switch, commit or publication. P06 not started.
